build_pixel_control_rewards: build pixel control rewards from observation sequences by computing average absolute pixel intensity change per cell
create_feature_control_rewards: create feature control cumulants from feature sequences with configurable cumulant types like absolute_change, increase, decrease, or potential
run_pixel_control_rewards: run pixel control rewards on a [T+1,H,W,C] observation tensor with a given cell_size to produce [T,H',W'] reward grid
test_feature_control_rewards: test feature control rewards with cumulant_type 'absolute_change' on a [T+1,D] feature tensor to get [T,D] output
review_feature_control_rewards: review feature control rewards supporting cumulant types feature, absolute_change, increase, decrease, and potential with optional discount
